name: Aston Martin
tagline: Aston Martin Real Estate & Branded Luxury Residences
description:
Aston Martin partnered with DarGlobal on The Astera, a Ras Al Khaimah development that brings the marque's first residential project to the Gulf. This landmark collaboration marks Aston Martin's entry into branded living, translating decades of automotive craftsmanship into architecture.

Two icons. Bound by a shared obsession with precision and craft. The result? Legendary performance, at home on one of the Gulf's most coveted coastlines. It's more than a residence, it's a legacy you can live in. It's power, poured into place.

projects.name: The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin

name: Elie Saab
tagline: ELIE SAAB Real Estate & Branded Luxury Residences
description:
Elie Saab partnered with DarGlobal on Les Vagues, a Qetaifan Island North development that brings the couturier's eye for line and detail to Qatar's coastline. This landmark collaboration marks Elie Saab's first co-branded residences, translating haute couture into a permanent address.

Two visionaries. One from the runway, one from the skyline. The result? Considered amenities, effortless convenience, and coastal elegance, gathered under one name. It's more than a home, it's a silhouette you live inside. It's fashion, made permanent.

name: Fendi Casa
tagline: Fendi Casa Real Estate & Branded Luxury Residences
description:
Fendi Casa partnered with DarGlobal on Azure Oceanfront Villas, an AIDA, Oman development that carries a century of Roman design heritage into residential interiors. This landmark collaboration marks Fendi Casa's continued expansion beyond fashion, translating the house's legacy of craftsmanship into a place to live.

Two houses. One built on decades of couture, one on decades of skyline. The result? Elegance, tradition, and experimentation, folded into every interior surface. It's more than a villa, it's a house history you can inhabit. It's Rome, brought to the sea.

projects.name: DarGlobal Mansions Interiors by Fendi Casa
Azure Oceanfront Villas Interiors by Fendi Casa

name: Automobili Lamborghini
tagline: Automobili Lamborghini Real Estate & Branded Luxury Residences
description:
Automobili Lamborghini partnered with DarGlobal on Tierra Viva, a Benahavís development that carries the marque's design DNA into southern Spain. This landmark collaboration marks Lamborghini's expression of performance engineering translated into finely crafted residential detail.

Two engines. One built for the road, one built for living. The result? Bold form, sharp lines, and uncompromising detail, set against the hills of Benahavís. It's more than a villa, it's a machine for living tuned to perform. It's performance, at rest.

projects.name: Tierra Viva, Design inspired by Automobili Lamborghini
Painite Villas Design Inspired by Automobili Lamborghini

name: Marriott
tagline: Marriott Real Estate & Branded Luxury Residences
description:
Marriott partnered with DarGlobal on Marriott Residences, a Muscat, Oman development at AIDA that brings five-star hospitality into everyday living. This landmark collaboration marks Marriott's expertise in service paired with DarGlobal's real estate craft in one address.

Two disciplines. Hospitality and home, meeting in the middle. The result? The seamless convenience of a world-class hotel, with the privacy of a residence you own. It's more than service, it's a lifestyle on call. It's five stars, permanently yours.

name: Missoni
tagline: Missoni Real Estate & Branded Luxury Residences
description:
Missoni partnered with DarGlobal on two residential concepts, Urban Oasis in Dubai and Marea on Spain's Costa del Sol. This landmark collaboration marks Missoni's first venture into branded real estate, carrying the house's signature color and craft into interior design.

Two capitals. One thread running through both. The result? Curated amenities and scenic views, dressed in the house's unmistakable palette. It's more than an interior, it's a wardrobe for a home. It's Italian style, laid in every room.

name: Mouawad
tagline: Mouawad Real Estate & Branded Luxury Residences
description:
Mouawad partnered with DarGlobal on Neptune Villas, a North Riyadh development that brings the jewelry house's mastery of rare materials into residential design. This landmark collaboration marks Mouawad's first foray into real estate, translating gemcraft into architecture.

Two connoisseurs. One cuts stone, one shapes cities. The result? Gemlike homes set within a lifestyle-rich setting of schools, parks, and dining. It's more than a villa, it's a rare find made to live in. It's brilliance, built to last.

name: Pagani
tagline: Pagani Real Estate & Branded Luxury Residences
description:
Pagani partnered with DarGlobal on the Da Vinci Tower, a Dubai development that pushes the limits of functionality and form. This landmark collaboration marks the performance automotive brand’s first foray into residential interiors.

Two visionaries. Engaged in the mutual pursuit of innovation and beauty. The result? Quality craftsmanship and personalized performance, in one of the world’s most dynamic cities. It’s more than a rarified investment and an exceptional way of life. It’s a tribute to true genius.

projects.name: Da Vinci Tower, Interiors by Pagani

name: Paramount
tagline: Paramount Real Estate & Branded Luxury Residences
description: Through its iconic entertainment portfolio, Paramount partners with global hospitality developers to bring beloved characters and immersive experiences to life. In collaboration with DarGlobal, they launched Nickelodeon Hotels & Resorts Aida, Oman, infusing world-class resorts with playful themed environments, signature family entertainment, character interactions, and standout attractions like Aqua Nick water parks, creating memorable destinations for families and fans worldwide.

name: The Trump Organization
tagline: The Trump Organization Real Estate & Branded Luxury Residences
description:
The Trump Organization partnered with DarGlobal across a portfolio spanning Dubai, Jeddah, and Muscat, from the Trump Penthouses to Trump Tower Jeddah. This landmark collaboration marks a shared pursuit of superlative design paired with premium locations across the Gulf.

Two names. Built on scale and reach. The result? Exclusive residences enriched with considered amenities and name-brand prestige, wherever the address. It's more than a portfolio, it's a signature on the skyline. It's presence, everywhere it lands.

name: W Hotels
tagline: W Hotels Real Estate & Branded Luxury Residences
description:
W Hotels partnered with DarGlobal on W Residences, a Dubai Downtown development that brings the brand's bold, urban-edged design language into residential living. This landmark collaboration marks W's vision for redefining modern luxury carried into a permanent address.

Two spirits. Both restless, both urban. The result? Contemporary amenities designed for how you actually live, steps from the city's icons. It's more than a residence, it's a stage for the city. It's luxury, wide awake.
